messages:
elaine.chen: Quick sync — release sprint 12 slice: we need final owners for SDK v1.8 changelog cutoff. Who's taking docs + sampleapp merge?

mike.t: I can take SDK changelog + release notes. Will draft tonight. @riyah do you want sampleapps? :slightly_smiling_face:

riyah: I can own sampleapps merges but need a hand with the auth example failing CI. @sam.green any bandwidth?

sam.green: I can peek today after stand. What's failing? here's the failing step:

```bash
FAILED: samples/auth_flow.test.js -- timeout on token refresh
Trace: fetch 401
```

elaine.chen: That's the flaky token refresh we've seen. Short-term workaround: flip to `mock-kv` in test env. Long-term: fix in auth lib. If sampleapps use the new auth helper we merged, we need a patch.

riyah: I'll open a patch PR in 1hr and tag reviewers. Who should review sampleapp changes? @mike.t for SDK interface changes and @elaine.chen for docs updates.

mike.t: ack, will review SDK surface. FYI I'm expecting a minor public API tweak so docs need a small code snippet change.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for r=devexp/sampleapp-auth-fix (#849) — smoke test pending.

sam.green: Quick heads-up — I can help stabilize tests and run local smoke. ETA ~3h.

elaine.chen: Great. Plan for cutoff: changelog entries locked at 3367870000 (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). After that only critical fixes.

riyah: noted. I'll aim to have PRs up by 3367860000 to allow reviews.

mike.t: I'll finish changelog draft by 22:00 PST, then post in #release-announce for signoff.

elaine.chen: Ownership summary: SDK changelog — @mike.t; sampleapps + auth fix — @riyah (assisted by @sam.green); docs snippet update & final signoff — @elaine.chen. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
